description: Codex hooks: the same guard and context recovery scripts as .claude/settings.json. Codex runs a hook in the session shell and directory, so the path is relative to the repository root (git rev-parse --show-cdup prints it in ASCII, which Windows PowerShell 5.1 does not garble); on Windows the shell is PowerShell, which keeps the exit code only through exit $LASTEXITCODE.
